articles.headline: Treble-collecting Mark Jackson ready to take Lion City Sailors to the next level
articles.description: Lion City Sailors' Mark Jackson era will begin on Thursday against BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: Mark Jackson of Lion City Sailors [1296x729]
images.caption: After his appointment was announced last week, Mark Jackson will take charge of Lion City Sailors for the first time on Thursday when they entertain BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: New Sailors coach Jackson relishes challenge of reaching Asian summit
images.caption: New Lion City Sailors coach Mark Jackson is ready to help the club establish themselves as one of Asia's best clubs, as he did with previous side Buriram United.

articles.headline: Ronaldo suffers biggest loss with Al Nassr in Asian CL rout
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo suffered his heaviest loss since joining Al Nassr as the Saudi Arabian champion kicked off its Asian Champions League Elite campaign with a 4-0 defeat to Al Ain

images.name: Ronaldo woe [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo and Al Nassr began the AFC Champions League Elite with a heavy loss to Al Ain.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo (R) of Al-Nassr in action during the AFC Champions League match between Al Ain and Al-Nassr at Hazza Bin Zayed Stadium in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates, on September 15, 2026.
images.credit: Hassan al Raisi/Anadolu via Getty Images

articles.headline: Treble-winning Sandy Walsh could not have asked for better first season at Buriram United
articles.description: Sandy Walsh enjoyed a success-filled first season with Buriram United -- but what does the future hold for him?

images.name: Sandy Walsh [1296x729]
images.caption: Sandy Walsh's first season at Buriram United saw him win three titles in the form of the Thai League 1, Thai FA Cup and ASEAN Club Championship.

images.name: Buriram's road to the ASEAN Club Championship crown
images.caption: Relive Buriram United's entire journey as they claimed a second consecutive ASEAN Club Championship title.

articles.headline: Tete Yengi credits journeyman career for World Cup call-up
articles.description: Socceroos bolter Tete Yengi says his journey to the national team has not been straightforward, but he believes these adventures have played a key role in his pursuit of becoming the "ultimate player" and, more importantly, a World Cup representative.
